requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS analytics product. Primary goal: replace slow keyword search with embeddings-backed semantic search across product docs + user events. Need reliable nightly batch ingestion (incremental upserts), sub-200ms retrieval latency at 150 qps, and bulk-embedding throughput to support daily re-index (~300k new/updated records nightly). High cost sensitivity; will compare Hosted API vs Dedicated TCO. Strong security: SSO, audit logs, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for a subset of records.
poc_spec: 4-week proof: 1) Hosted API quick POC to validate embedding quality and query relevance on sample corpus (150k docs). 2) Dedicated POC for throughput: sustained 150 qps retrieval tests + nightly batch ingestion of 300k items (embeddings generated and upserted). Validate vector DB integration w/ Pinecone and Weaviate connectors. Success metrics: MRR uplift (search CTR + reduced time-to-answer), retrieval 95p < 120ms, nightly pipeline completes within 2 hours.
cost_sensitivity_notes: Budget: aiming <$100k ARR incremental for initial contract. Primary ask: clear cost-per-embedding and cost-per-1000-queries breakdown. Interested in quantization and batching recommendations to reduce token cost for embeddings generation. Asking for Dedicated reserved pricing + overage/burst terms.
technical_constraints: Docs vary in length (short UI strings to 8k char product guides). Need support for variable-dimension embeddings (prefer 1536) and deterministic reranking reproducibility. Pipeline: S3 -> ingest workers -> embed generator -> vectordb upserts. Nightly windows must not exceed 3 hours due to ETL downstream jobs.
security_and_compliance: Require SSO/SAML integration for Console, SOC2 evidence, audit logging (per-request), and customer KMS integration for key wrapping. Partial data residency: EU-only index for EEA customers. Legal requested clause for data deletion and retention controls.
